_notes: formEndpoint: set to a form-submission URL (e.g. a Formspree/Basin/Getform endpoint or your own API). It is a public URL, not a secret. Leave empty until configured; the form then says it is not connected and never reports success. officeHours: leave empty to hide; set e.g. "Mon–Fri, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM" when confirmed. siteUrl: set to the public address (e.g. https://opspilot.ph, no trailing slash) once the domain is connected; the build then adds canonical/og:url tags and sitemap.xml.
